image_slots.prompt: A bright, friendly children's-textbook illustration of a village primary school on a sunny day. A two-storey school building with a red-and-white facade and rows of windows, a small pillared entrance porch with a blue door, set behind a tidy garden of flowering plants and green shrubs bordered with bricks. Potted flowering plants along a paved path; an open grassy field in the foreground; leafy trees on both sides. Soft watercolour style, warm daylight, clear blue sky with light clouds. No people, no birds, no animals — buildings, garden, field, sky and plants only. Flat front-facing composition suitable for a young child's reading book. High contrast and clean linework so it stays legible in black-and-white photocopy.
